debt.text: Carl campaigns on fiscal restraint and balancing the federal budget, saying the government should live within its means.
debt.quote: Washington needs to live within its means, just like families and small-businesses do every day

schools.text: Said he supports school choice, including vouchers, tax credits, charter schools, private schools and homeschooling, and supports eliminating the U.S. Department of Education.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.

safety.text: Carl positions himself as a strong backer of police and law enforcement.
safety.quote: Jerry has always been a strong supporter of law enforcement

immigration.text: Carl calls for building the border wall, more Border Patrol agents, and opposing illegal immigration.
immigration.quote: illegal immigration is a direct threat to our national security

guns.text: Carl describes himself as a lifelong Second Amendment supporter who will defend gun rights.
guns.quote: lifelong supporter of the Second Amendment and will defend our right to bear and keep arms

abortion.text: Carl says he is 100% pro-life and opposes public funding of abortion.
abortion.quote: Jerry Carl is 100% pro-life and opposes any tax dollars being used to fund abortions

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Carl says he has worked to keep transgender athletes out of women's sports.
gender.quote: He has led the charge to protect women's sports, and he will work with President Trump

tax.text: Jones advocated for reducing Alabama’s grocery tax while serving with Alabama Arise.
tax.quote: pushed to achieve the state’s grocery tax reduction reached in 2025

wages.text: Jones calls for a livable wage in coastal Alabama and backs the right to unionize and protections like overtime pay and paid leave.
wages.quote: In Baldwin County alone, a single person has to make at least $22 an hour to live here.

immigration.text: Jones calls for immigration reform with a path for undocumented people to gain legal status and says law-abiding immigrants should not be targeted, while also saying secure borders are necessary.
immigration.quote: While it's important to hold criminals accountable, law abiding immigrants shouldn't be caught in the crosshairs to hit a quota.

health.text: Jones supports expanding Medicaid, restoring enhanced Affordable Care Act subsidies and creating direct federal coverage for residents of states that do not expand Medicaid.
health.quote: I believe in the expansion of Medicaid , and ACA Enhanced Premium Tax Credits to ease the burden of health care on every day Americans.
